feature_text.availability: games / his team's games while rostered so far; missing -> that snapshot's mean
feature_text.kept: kept this season (carried on a trade); 0 for everyone in 2021-22
feature_text.level: FPPG so far shrunk toward the prior, w = k/(k+k0); k0 13 (last season) or 4.7 (league mean)
feature_text.undrafted: neither kept nor drafted this season

level_prior.k0_league_mean_source: measured 10-23 against the league mean (variance components, 589 player-seasons)
level_prior.k0_prior_source: measured 2026-10-29 on this run's playerlog, the method of REVIEW_PROJECTION_VS_ACTUALS_RESULT_2026-10-23 s4: 485 player-seasons at k=10, 3845 (k, player-season) pairs

prior.on: each coefficient times its feature's scale (an indicator as is, a continuous input at 2 sd); Gelman et al. 2008. Stops quasi-separation: plain ML put 'undrafted' at week 2 at -23.7

why: features: step B's comparison (age linear); H56: no draft rank (the pick order before 2024-25 is punted).
